verdict.rationale: GrowthBook supports headless/CI usage via self-hosted Docker Compose deployment, a full REST API, SDK Connection Endpoints for programmatic flag evaluation, and inline server-side experiments requiring no third-party requests — all scriptable without a UI. A runtime probe confirms a real keyless self-host create-and-evaluate loop via API/docker, demonstrating genuine automation capability. missing for 10: no explicit CI/CD pipeline example or GitHub Actions integration doc, and no evidence of a dedicated CLI tool for automation workflows.
